Okay, and then, venture south. With that over with, make an attempt to move east. And then, go to the east. And then, attempt to move north. After that, make an effort to move north. That done, head east. Then, travel north. If you can do that, make an effort to take a trip east. Then, move east. And then, take a trip east. Once you accomplish that, go to the south. Following that, go west. After that, try to go west. Then, attempt to travel south. Following that, make an attempt to go to the west. Then, make an effort to venture south. After that, venture east. Following that, try to take a trip north. And then, make an attempt to take a trip north. After that, attempt to take a trip north. If you can do that, move east. After that, go to the east. And then, attempt to go east. With that accomplished, attempt to head east. Then, travel north. Following that, make an attempt to go north. Then, take a trip north. And then, move north. After that, make an effort to take a trip north. And then, move north. Following that, try to venture east. Following that, recover the coin from the floor of the hot canteen. And if you do that, you're the winner!
